title: Establish baselines from confirmed coherent retained scope
statement: The MOD-005 responsibility shall establish baselines from confirmed coherent retained scope within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Baseline orchestration and catalog establishment can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Establish baselines from confirmed coherent retained scope.

why.rationale: SR-020 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests baseline orchestration and catalog establishment.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Baseline orchestration and catalog establishment. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Bind a unique project baseline identity to exact membership, original definitions and relationships, metamodel/rules, provenance, included material and external-only exclusions.
Require complete required acquisition, original interpretation and accountable coherence support; mechanical validity alone does not establish adequate coherent scope.
Obtain exact content-custody confirmation before publishing the baseline descriptor; establish retention only after descriptor and sealed bundle readback agree.
Preserve earlier descriptor content and original interpretation when the current model changes; same identity with different retained content conflicts.
Report partial custody, sealed-but-unregistered content, missing rules and uncertain catalog effects without an established complete baseline; reconcile exact effects before retry.
Apply existing authority and retention policy to the exact request without turning inspection, coherence or retention into approval.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
